attempts.exactPrompt:
Create exactly one full-body Summonlab combat chibi derived only from the supplied verified summon portrait. Canvas 1024 x 1536. Keep the character an adult and unmistakably the exact same person; simplify shapes for a clean painterly combat-game chibi, approximately 2.75 to 3.1 heads tall, with a large readable head but no generic inflation of the body. Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Identity continuity: Rao Falin, age 18, gender presentation woman, skin-value band 5; long narrow face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; broad low bridge, full lips; one brow notch Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. Body continuity: clearly-muscular, very-tall; 199 cm; clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms. Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. The sole reference is the exact candidate authorized by summon target rao-falin-summon-v1 and verified result rao-falin-summon-v1-result at assets/heroes/experiments/one-star-overnight-200-001/waves/wave-01/results/rao-falin/summon-v1.json; these identifiers are provenance only and must not appear in the image. No other identity, anatomy, wardrobe, or style reference is authorized. No weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, extra person, duplicate anatomy, cropped extremity, baby proportions, photographic finish, plastic 3D, or published-character resemblance.

findings.observation: The adult face remains recognizably Rao through the same medium-deep skin, long facial construction, high cheekbones, broad low bridge, full lips, brow notch, and calm closed mouth.
The source muscular construction remains specific: broad readable shoulders, narrow waist, developed arms and legs, grounded posture, and no added softness.
Upper arms and forearms retain Rao’s source muscularity while wrists and hands remain coherent and do not show generic ballooning or duplicate digits.
Dark-brown gathered hair, the large architectural wrapped high knot, side braiding, and one unruly front curl closely preserve the summon silhouette.
The teal-brown split tabard, contrasting inner trim, waist wrap, patched hand repairs, loose dark trousers, wrapped ankles, and worn shoes all remain legible without new accessories or markings.

The full figure reads approximately 3.7 heads tall even when the tall knot is included in the head mass, outside the required 2.75–3.1 range; the head must be enlarged relative to the unchanged body identity in a new target version.
Exactly one complete figure is present with the entire knot, both empty hands, and both feet inside generous margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, separated limbs, strong silhouette, and restrained detail remain readable at combat-icon scale.
The image remains ordinary mortal workwear with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, affinity cue, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.
